senses.gloss: m. (= שרשריפא, redupl. of שרף, Shaf. of רפף, v. שְׁרַפְרַף) camp-stool, chair.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 129a:11">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>לרבה צלחו ליה ש׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שרשפא</he>) for Rabbah they chopped up a chair (for kindling wood for the preparation of the Sabbath meals).
<cite ref="Ketubot 61a:11">Keth. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>רב פפא אש׳</he> for R. P. his wife placed the cup on a chair.
